title: Мигающий зелёный
adaptation: Signalised junction: the south and north main greens flash at 1 Hz, east and west are red. One red coupe at the south stop line. After the answer a close-up of the flashing head from red's seat, then red goes straight north while the green still flashes; yellow comes on 4.6 s after red starts, when it has left the junction.
